    <!doctype html>
    <html lang="ru">
    <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1" />
    <title>MyGps Admin</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css" crossorigin=""/>
    <link rel="manifest" href="manifest.webmanifest">
    <style>
    :root{
    --bg:#0f172a;
    --card:#111827;
    --muted:#94a3b8;
    --text:#e5e7eb;
    --accent:#22c55e;
    --warn:#eab308;
    --danger:#ef4444;
    --border:#1f2937;
    --blue:#2563eb;
    }
    *{box-sizing:border-box}
    body{margin:0;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,Arial,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text)}
    .wrap{max-width:1440px;margin:0 auto;padding:16px}
    .card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:20px;padding:16px;margin-bottom:16px}
    h1,h2,h3,p{margin:0}
    .sub{color:var(--muted);margin-top:6px;line-height:1.6}
    .headerTime{margin-top:8px;color:var(--muted)}
    .grid2,.grid3,.grid4,.grid6{display:grid;gap:12px;margin-top:12px}
    .grid2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
    .grid3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}
    .grid4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}
    .grid6{grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr))}
    .stat{background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;padding:12px}
    .label{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;margin-bottom:6px}
    .value{font-size:18px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.2;word-break:break-word}
    .row{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-top:12px}
    .tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:12px}
    .tab-btn{background:#1f2937}
    .tab-btn.active{background:var(--blue)}
    .hidden{display:none!important}
    input,button,select,textarea{font:inherit}
    input,select,textarea{
    padding:12px 14px;
    border-radius:12px;
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    background:#0b1220;
    color:var(--text);
    min-width:120px
    }
    button{
    border:0;border-radius:12px;padding:10px 14px;
    font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;color:white;background:var(--blue)
    }
    button.secondary{background:#374151}
    button.warn{background:#b45309}
    button.danger{background:#b91c1c}
    button.success{background:#15803d}
    button.small{padding:6px 10px;font-size:13px}
    button:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:not-allowed}
    .pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);font-size:14px}
    .dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;display:inline-block}
    .ok{background:var(--accent)}
    .notice,.address-box,.error{padding:12px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);margin-top:12px;line-height:1.6}
    .error{border-color:#7f1d1d;background:rgba(127,29,29,.25);color:#fecaca}
    .mono{font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;font-size:13px;word-break:break-all}
    table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin-top:12px;font-size:14px}
    th,td{border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:10px 8px;text-align:left;vertical-align:top}
    th{color:var(--muted)}
    tr.clickable{cursor:pointer}
    tr.clickable:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
    tr.day-separator td{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);font-weight:700;color:#cbd5e1}
    #historyMap,#liveMap,#sessionMap{width:100%;height:420px;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--border);margin-top:12px}
    .chartWrap{background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:16px;padding:12px}
    .tag{display:inline-block;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--border);font-size:12px;margin-right:6px;margin-bottom:6px}
    @media (max-width:1200px){.grid6{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}}
    @media (max-width:1000px){.grid4{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.grid3,.grid2{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
    @media (max-width:900px){
    .grid4,.grid6{grid-template-columns:1fr}
    input,select,textarea{min-width:unset;width:100%}
    .row>*{width:100%}
    #historyMap,#liveMap,#sessionMap{height:320px}
    }
    </style>
    </head>
    <body>
    <div class="wrap">
    <div class="card">
    <h1>MyGps Admin</h1>
    <div id="pageDateTime" class="headerTime">—</div>
    <p class="sub">История, live, отчёты и управление временными live-ссылками.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="card" id="authCard">
    <h2>Вход</h2>
    <div class="row"><button id="googleBtn">Войти через Google</button></div>
    <div class="row">
    <input id="emailInput" type="email" placeholder="Email"/>
    <input id="passwordInput" type="password" placeholder="Пароль"/>
    </div>
    <div class="row">
    <button id="emailLoginBtn" class="secondary">Войти по Email</button>
    <button id="emailRegisterBtn" class="success">Создать Email-аккаунт</button>
    </div>
    <div class="notice" id="authMessage">Если после входа доступа нет, добавь свой UID в Firebase: <span class="mono">admins/ТВОЙ_UID = true</span></div>
    <div id="errorBox" class="error hidden"></div>
    </div>
    <div id="adminPanel" class="hidden">
    <div class="card">
    <div class="row">
    <div class="pill"><span class="dot ok"></span><span id="userInfo">Вы вошли</span></div>
    <button id="logoutBtn" class="secondary">Выйти</button>
    </div>
    <div class="tabs">
    <button class="tab-btn active" data-tab="nowPanel">Сейчас</button>
    <button class="tab-btn" data-tab="historyPanel">История</button>
    <button class="tab-btn" data-tab="reportsPanel">Отчёты</button>
    <button class="tab-btn" data-tab="usagePanel">Объём</button>
    <button class="tab-btn" data-tab="sessionsPanel">Live-сессии</button>
    <button class="tab-btn" data-tab="journalPanel">Журнал</button>
    </div>
    </div>
    <div id="nowPanel">
    <div class="card">
    <h2>Сейчас</h2>
    <div class="grid4">
    <div class="stat"><div class="label">Статус</div><div class="value" id="nowStatus">Нет данных</div></div>
    <div class="stat"><div class="label">Источник</div><div class="value" id="nowSource">—</div></div>
    <div class="stat"><div class="label">Скорость</div><div class="value" id="nowSpeed">—</div></div>
    <div class="stat"><div class="label">Точность</div><div class="value" id="nowAccuracy">—</div></div>
    <div class="stat"><div class="label">Последнее обновление</div><div class="value" id="nowUpdated">—</div></div>
    <div class="stat"><div class="label">Направление</div><div class="value" id="nowBearing">—</div></div>
    <div class="stat"><div class="label">Простой</div><div class="value" id="nowIdle">—</div></div>
    <div class="stat"><div class="label">Адрес</div><div class="value" id="nowAddress">—</div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="row">
    <button id="liveAutoCenterBtn">Автоцентр: вкл</button>
    <button id="refreshNowBtn" class="secondary">Обновить сейчас</button>
    </div>
    <div id="liveMap"></div>
    </div>
    </div>
    <div id="historyPanel" class="hidden">
    <div class="card">
    <h2>Фильтры и период</h2>
    <div class="grid6">
    <div><div class="label">Дата от</div><input id="fromDate" type="date"/></div>
    <div><div class="label">Часы от</div><select id="fromHour"></select></div>
    <div><div class="label">Минуты от</div><select id="fromMinute"></select></div>
    <div><div class="label">Дата до</div><input id="toDate" type="date"/></div>
    <div><div class="label">Часы до</div><select id="toHour"></select></div>
    <div><div class="label">Минуты до</div><select id="toMinute"></select></div>
    </div>
    <div class="row">
    <button id="todayBtn">Сегодня</button>
    <button id="yesterdayBtn" class="secondary">Вчера</button>
    <button id="weekBtn" class="secondary">Неделя</button>
    <button id="range1hBtn" class="secondary">1 час</button>
    <button id="range24hBtn" class="secondary">24 часа</button>
    <button id="refreshHistoryBtn">Обновить историю</button>
    </div>
    <div class="row">
    <input id="maxAccuracyFilter" type="number" min="0" step="1" placeholder="Макс. accuracy, м"/>
    <input id="minSpeedFilter" type="number" min="0" step="0.1" placeholder="Скорость от, км/ч"/>
    <input id="maxSpeedFilter" type="number" min="0" step="0.1" placeholder="Скорость до, км/ч"/>
    <label class="pill"><input id="hideJunkToggle" type="checkbox" style="width:auto;min-width:auto"/> Скрыть мусорные</label>
    <button id="applyFiltersBtn" class="secondary">Применить</button>
    <button id="resetFiltersBtn" class="secondary">Сбросить</button>
    </div>
    <div class="row">
    <button id="fitRouteBtn" class="secondary">Центрировать маршрут</button>
    <button id="exportJsonBtn" class="secondary">JSON</button>
    <button id="exportCsvBtn" class="secondary">CSV</button>

    <script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js" crossorigin=""></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jspdf@2.5.1/dist/jspdf.umd.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jspdf-autotable@3.8.2/dist/jspdf.plugin.autotable.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.1/dist/chart.umd.min.js"></script>
    <script type="module">
    import { initializeApp } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.5/firebase-app.js";
    import {
    getAuth, GoogleAuthProvider, signInWithPopup,
    signInWithEmailAndPassword, createUserWithEmailAndPassword,
    onAuthStateChanged, signOut
    } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.5/firebase-auth.js";
    import {
    getDatabase, ref, get, onValue, remove, update, push, set
    } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.5/firebase-database.js";
    const firebaseConfig = {
    apiKey: "AIzaSyCXNCY-IpkhAXb8jNPhN8gf2UdOfPBc5gM",
    authDomain: "mygpslive-57196.firebaseapp.com",
    databaseURL: "https://mygpslive-57196-default-rtdb.europe-west1.firebasedatabase.app",
    projectId: "mygpslive-57196",
    storageBucket: "mygpslive-57196.firebasestorage.app",
    messagingSenderId: "20781107701",
    appId: "1:20781107701:web:bd47061b9aca13abbeb8bc",
    measurementId: "G-BSCVNY9LH0"
    };
    const app = initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
    const auth = getAuth(app);
    const db = getDatabase(app);
    const provider = new GoogleAuthProvider();
    const qs = (id)=>document.getElementById(id);
    let allHistoryPoints = [];
    let allSessions = {};
    let liveDefaultData = null;
    let deletionsLog = [];
    let actionLogs = [];
    let currentFiltered = [];
    let liveAutoCenter = true;
    let currentNowSourceLabel = "—";
    let speedChart = null;
    let distanceChart = null;
    let createdShareUrl = "";
    let isBusy = false;
    function errText(e){ return e?.message || e?.code || String(e); }
    async function runSafe(label, fn, opts = {}){
    if (isBusy) return;
    try{
    isBusy = true;
    await fn();
    if (opts.reloadSessions) await loadSessions();
    if (opts.reloadHistory) await loadHistory();
    if (!opts.silentSuccess) console.log(label + " OK");
    }catch(e){
    console.error(label, e);
    alert(label + ":\n" + errText(e));
    }finally{
    isBusy = false;
    }
    }
    function populateTimeSelects(){
    const hourOpts = Array.from({length:24}, (_,i)=>`<option value="${String(i).padStart(2,"0")}">${String(i).padStart(2,"0")}</option>`).join("");
    const minuteOpts = Array.from({length:60}, (_,i)=>`<option value="${String(i).padStart(2,"0")}">${String(i).padStart(2,"0")}</option>`).join("");
    qs("fromHour").innerHTML = hourOpts;
    qs("toHour").innerHTML = hourOpts;
    qs("fromMinute").innerHTML = minuteOpts;
    qs("toMinute").innerHTML = minuteOpts;
    }
    populateTimeSelects();
    function renderHeaderTime(){
    const d = new Date();
    const days=["воскресенье","понедельник","вторник","среда","четверг","пятница","суббота"];
    qs("pageDateTime").textContent = `${days[d.getDay()]}, ${d.toLocaleString("ru-RU")}`;
    }
    setInterval(renderHeaderTime, 1000);
    renderHeaderTime();
    document.querySelectorAll(".tab-btn").forEach(btn=>{
    btn.onclick=()=>{
    document.querySelectorAll(".tab-btn").forEach(b=>b.classList.remove("active"));
    document.querySelectorAll("#nowPanel,#historyPanel,#reportsPanel,#usagePanel,#sessionsPanel,#journalPanel").forEach(p=>p.classList.add("hidden"));
    btn.classList.add("active");
    qs(btn.dataset.tab).classList.remove("hidden");
    setTimeout(()=>{
    historyMap.invalidateSize();
    liveMap.invalidateSize();
    sessionMap.invalidateSize();
    speedChart?.resize();
    distanceChart?.resize();
    },50);
    };
    });
    function fmtTime(v){ return v ? new Date(v).toLocaleString("ru-RU") : "—"; }
    function formatDuration(ms){
    if(!ms || ms < 0) return "—";
    const s = Math.floor(ms/1000), h = Math.floor(s/3600), m = Math.floor((s%3600)/60);
    return h > 0 ? `${h}ч ${m}м` : `${m}м`;
    }
    function formatIdle(ms){
    if(!ms || ms < 1000) return "—";
    const s=Math.floor(ms/1000), h=Math.floor(s/3600), m=Math.floor((s%3600)/60), sec=s%60;
    return h>0?`${h}ч ${m}м ${sec}с`:`${m}м ${sec}с`;
    }
    function formatSize(bytes){
    if(bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
    if(bytes < 1024*1024) return `${(bytes/1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
    return `${(bytes/(1024*1024)).toFixed(2)} MB`;
    }
    function parseDateTime(dateVal,hVal,mVal){
    if(!dateVal) return null;
    return new Date(`${dateVal}T${hVal||"00"}:${mVal||"00"}:00`).getTime();
    }
    function setDateTimeRange(start,end){
    qs("fromDate").value = start.toISOString().slice(0,10);
    qs("fromHour").value = String(start.getHours()).padStart(2,"0");
    qs("fromMinute").value = String(start.getMinutes()).padStart(2,"0");
    qs("toDate").value = end.toISOString().slice(0,10);
    qs("toHour").value = String(end.getHours()).padStart(2,"0");
    qs("toMinute").value = String(end.getMinutes()).padStart(2,"0");
    }
    function setDefaultPeriodToday(){
    const now = new Date(), start = new Date();
    start.setHours(0,0,0,0);
    setDateTimeRange(start, now);
    }
    function distanceMeters(a,b){
    const toRad=(v)=>v*Math.PI/180, R=6371000;
    const dLat=toRad(b.latitude-a.latitude), dLon=toRad(b.longitude-a.longitude);
    const lat1=toRad(a.latitude), lat2=toRad(b.latitude);
    const x=Math.sin(dLat/2)**2+Math.sin(dLon/2)**2*Math.cos(lat1)*Math.cos(lat2);
    return R*(2*Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(x), Math.sqrt(1-x)));
    }
    function looksJunk(prev, cur){
    const acc = Number(cur.accuracy||0);
    const sp = Number(cur.speed||0);
    if(acc > 100) return true;
    if(prev){
    const dist = distanceMeters(prev, cur);
    const dt = Math.max(1, (Number(cur.timestamp||0)-Number(prev.timestamp||0))/1000);
    const calcSpeed = dist/dt*3.6;
    if(sp <= 0.5 && calcSpeed > 30) return true;
    if(calcSpeed > 250) return true;
    }
    return false;
    }
    function filteredHistory(){
    const from=parseDateTime(qs("fromDate").value, qs("fromHour").value, qs("fromMinute").value);
    const to=parseDateTime(qs("toDate").value, qs("toHour").value, qs("toMinute").value);
    const maxAcc=Number(qs("maxAccuracyFilter").value||0);
    const minSp=Number(qs("minSpeedFilter").value||0);
    const maxSp=Number(qs("maxSpeedFilter").value||0);
    const hideJunk=qs("hideJunkToggle").checked;
    return allHistoryPoints.filter((p,idx,arr)=>{
    const t=Number(p.timestamp||0), sp=Number(p.speed||0), acc=Number(p.accuracy||0);
    if(from&&t<from) return false;
    if(to&&t>to) return false;
    if(maxAcc>0&&acc>maxAcc) return false;
    if(minSp>0&&sp<minSp) return false;
    if(maxSp>0&&sp>maxSp) return false;
    if(hideJunk&&looksJunk(arr[idx-1],p)) return false;
    return true;
    });
    }
    function computeSummary(points){
    if(!points.length) return {count:0, km:0, avgSpeed:0, maxSpeed:0};
    let meters=0;
    for(let i=1;i<points.length;i++) meters += distanceMeters(points[i-1], points[i]);
    const speeds=points.map(p=>Number(p.speed||0)).filter(v=>Number.isFinite(v)&&v>0);
    return {
    count: points.length,
    km: meters/1000,
    avgSpeed: speeds.length ? speeds.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/speeds.length : 0,
    maxSpeed: speeds.length ? Math.max(...speeds) : 0
    };
    }
    function detectStops(points){
    const stops=[];
    let startIdx=null;
    for(let i=0;i<points.length;i++){
    const sp=Number(points[i].speed||0);
    if(sp<=2){
    if(startIdx===null) startIdx=i;
    }else if(startIdx!==null){
    const duration=Number(points[i-1].timestamp||0)-Number(points[startIdx].timestamp||0);
    if(duration>=5*60*1000) stops.push({start:points[startIdx], end:points[i-1], duration});
    startIdx=null;
    }
    }
    if(startIdx!==null && points.length){
    const duration=Number(points[points.length-1].timestamp||0)-Number(points[startIdx].timestamp||0);
    if(duration>=5*60*1000) stops.push({start:points[startIdx], end:points[points.length-1], duration});
    }
    return stops;
    }
    const historyMap = L.map("historyMap").setView([56.95,24.10],12);
    const liveMap = L.map("liveMap").setView([56.95,24.10],12);
    const sessionMap = L.map("sessionMap").setView([56.95,24.10],12);
    L.tileLayer("https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png",{attribution:"&copy; OpenStreetMap"}).addTo(historyMap);
    L.tileLayer("https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png",{attribution:"&copy; OpenStreetMap"}).addTo(liveMap);
    L.tileLayer("https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png",{attribution:"&copy; OpenStreetMap"}).addTo(sessionMap);
    const liveTrail = L.polyline([], {weight:5}).addTo(liveMap);
    const liveMarker = L.circleMarker([56.95,24.10], {radius:8,color:"#22c55e",fillColor:"#22c55e",fillOpacity:1}).addTo(liveMap);
    const sessionTrail = L.polyline([], {weight:5}).addTo(sessionMap);
    const sessionMarker = L.circleMarker([56.95,24.10], {radius:8,color:"#22c55e",fillColor:"#22c55e",fillOpacity:1}).addTo(sessionMap);
    let routeSegments = [];
    const startMarker = L.marker([56.95,24.10]).addTo(historyMap);
    const endMarker = L.marker([56.95,24.10]).addTo(historyMap);
    function clearRouteSegments(){ routeSegments.forEach(s=>historyMap.removeLayer(s)); routeSegments=[]; }
    async function reverseGeocode(lat,lon){
    return `${lat.toFixed(5)}, ${lon.toFixed(5)}`;
    }
    async function updateHistoryMap(points){
    clearRouteSegments();
    const latlngs=points.filter(p=>p.latitude!=null&&p.longitude!=null).map(p=>[Number(p.latitude),Number(p.longitude)]);
    if(!latlngs.length) return;
    for(let i=1;i<points.length;i++){
    const a=[Number(points[i-1].latitude), Number(points[i-1].longitude)];
    const b=[Number(points[i].latitude), Number(points[i].longitude)];
    const seg=L.polyline([a,b], {weight:5,color:"#60a5fa"}).addTo(historyMap);
    routeSegments.push(seg);
    }
    const first=points[0], last=points[points.length-1];
    startMarker.setLatLng([Number(first.latitude), Number(first.longitude)]);
    endMarker.setLatLng([Number(last.latitude), Number(last.longitude)]);
    if(latlngs.length===1) historyMap.setView(latlngs[0],16);
    else historyMap.fitBounds(L.latLngBounds(latlngs), {padding:[30,30]});
    qs("startAddress").textContent = await reverseGeocode(Number(first.latitude), Number(first.longitude));
    qs("endAddress").textContent = await reverseGeocode(Number(last.latitude), Number(last.longitude));
    }
    function updateUsage(){
    const historyObj = Object.fromEntries(allHistoryPoints.map(p => [String(p.timestamp), p]));
    const historyBytes = new Blob([JSON.stringify(historyObj)]).size;
    const sessionsBytes = new Blob([JSON.stringify(allSessions||{})]).size + new Blob([JSON.stringify(liveDefaultData||{})]).size;
    qs("historySize").textContent = formatSize(historyBytes);
    qs("sessionsSize").textContent = formatSize(sessionsBytes);
    qs("totalSize").textContent = formatSize(historyBytes + sessionsBytes);
    qs("historyCount").textContent = String(allHistoryPoints.length);
    }
    function updateCharts(points){
    const speedLabels = points.slice(-100).map(p => new Date(Number(p.timestamp||0)).toLocaleTimeString("ru-RU",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit"}));
    const speedData = points.slice(-100).map(p => Number(p.speed||0));
    if(speedChart) speedChart.destroy();
    speedChart = new Chart(qs("speedChart"), {
    type:"line",
    data:{ labels:speedLabels, datasets:[{ data:speedData, tension:0.25 }] },
    options:{ responsive:true, plugins:{ legend:{display:false}}, scales:{ y:{beginAtZero:true}} }
    });
    const byDay={};
    for(let i=0;i<points.length;i++){
    const day=new Date(Number(points[i].timestamp||0)).toLocaleDateString("ru-RU");
    byDay[day]=byDay[day]||{dist:0,count:0,max:0,sum:0};
    if(i>0) byDay[day].dist += distanceMeters(points[i-1], points[i])/1000;
    const sp=Number(points[i].speed||0);
    byDay[day].count += 1;
    byDay[day].sum += sp;
    byDay[day].max = Math.max(byDay[day].max, sp);
    }
    const labels=Object.keys(byDay);
    const vals=labels.map(d=>Number(byDay[d].dist.toFixed(2)));
    if(distanceChart) distanceChart.destroy();
    distanceChart = new Chart(qs("distanceChart"), {
    type:"bar",
    data:{ labels, datasets:[{ data:vals }] },
    options:{ responsive:true, plugins:{ legend:{display:false}}, scales:{ y:{beginAtZero:true}} }
    });
    const tbody=qs("dailyStatsTbody");
    tbody.innerHTML="";
    labels.forEach(d=>{
    const item=byDay[d];
    const tr=document.createElement("tr");
    tr.innerHTML=`<td>${d}</td><td>${item.dist.toFixed(2)}</td><td>${(item.sum/Math.max(1,item.count)).toFixed(1)} км/ч</td><td>${item.max.toFixed(1)} км/ч</td><td>${item.count}</td>`;
    tbody.appendChild(tr);
    });
    }
    function renderHistory(){
    const pts=filteredHistory();
    currentFiltered=pts;
    const s=computeSummary(pts);
    const stops=detectStops(pts);
    qs("pointsCount").textContent=String(s.count);
    qs("distanceValue").textContent=`${s.km.toFixed(2)} км`;
    qs("avgSpeedValue").textContent=`${s.avgSpeed.toFixed(1)} км/ч`;
    qs("maxSpeedValue").textContent=`${s.maxSpeed.toFixed(1)} км/ч`;
    qs("routeStartCoords").textContent=pts.length?`${Number(pts[0].latitude).toFixed(5)}, ${Number(pts[0].longitude).toFixed(5)}`:"—";
    qs("routeEndCoords").textContent=pts.length?`${Number(pts[pts.length-1].latitude).toFixed(5)}, ${Number(pts[pts.length-1].longitude).toFixed(5)}`:"—";
    qs("routeDuration").textContent=pts.length?formatDuration(Number(pts[pts.length-1].timestamp||0)-Number(pts[0].timestamp||0)):"—";
    qs("routeStops").textContent=String(stops.length);
    qs("stopsNotice").textContent=stops.length?`Стоянки: ${stops.map(s=>formatDuration(s.duration)).join(", ")}`:"Стоянок не найдено.";
    const tbody=qs("historyTbody");
    tbody.innerHTML="";
    pts.slice().reverse().slice(0,500).forEach((p)=>{
    const tr=document.createElement("tr");
    tr.innerHTML=`<td>${fmtTime(p.timestamp)}</td><td class="mono">${Number(p.latitude).toFixed(5)}, ${Number(p.longitude).toFixed(5)}</td><td>${p.accuracy ?? "—"}</td><td>${p.speed != null ? Number(p.speed).toFixed(1)+" км/ч" : "—"}</td><td>${looksJunk(null,p)?'<span class="tag">мусор</span>':"—"}</td><td><button class="danger small">Удалить</button></td>`;
    tr.querySelector("button").onclick=async()=>{
    if(!confirm(`Удалить точку ${fmtTime(p.timestamp)}?`)) return;
    await runSafe("Удаление точки", async()=>{
    await logDeletion("point", `${fmtTime(p.timestamp)}`);
    await remove(ref(db, `history/default/${String(p.timestamp)}`));
    }, { reloadHistory:true, silentSuccess:true });
    };
    tbody.appendChild(tr);
    });
    updateHistoryMap(pts);
    updateCharts(pts);
    }
    function updateNowUI(point, sourceLabel, recentPoints=[]){
    currentNowSourceLabel = sourceLabel || "—";
    if(point && point.latitude != null && point.longitude != null){
    const lat=Number(point.latitude), lon=Number(point.longitude);
    liveMarker.setLatLng([lat,lon]);
    if(liveAutoCenter) liveMap.setView([lat,lon],16);
    qs("nowAddress").textContent = `${lat.toFixed(5)}, ${lon.toFixed(5)}`;
    }else{
    qs("nowAddress").textContent = "—";
    }
    const freshness = point?.timestamp ? Date.now() - Number(point.timestamp) : null;
    const isOnline = freshness != null && freshness <= 3*60*1000;
    qs("nowStatus").textContent = isOnline ? "Онлайн" : "Оффлайн";
    qs("nowSource").textContent = sourceLabel || "—";
    qs("nowSpeed").textContent = point?.speed != null ? `${Number(point.speed).toFixed(1)} км/ч` : "—";
    qs("nowAccuracy").textContent = point?.accuracy != null ? `${point.accuracy} м` : "—";
    qs("nowUpdated").textContent = fmtTime(point?.timestamp);
    qs("nowBearing").textContent = point?.bearing != null ? `${Number(point.bearing).toFixed(0)}°` : "—";
    qs("nowIdle").textContent = point?.timestamp ? formatIdle(Date.now()-Number(point.timestamp)) : "—";
    }
    function updateNowFromAvailableSources(){
    if(liveDefaultData && liveDefaultData.lastPoint){
    const pts = Object.values(liveDefaultData.recentPoints || {}).filter(Boolean).sort((a,b)=>Number(a.timestamp||0)-Number(b.timestamp||0));
    liveTrail.setLatLngs(pts.filter(p=>p.latitude!=null&&p.longitude!=null).map(p=>[Number(p.latitude),Number(p.longitude)]));
    updateNowUI(liveDefaultData.lastPoint, "live/default", pts);
    return;
    }
    const now = Date.now();
    const active = Object.entries(allSessions)
    .filter(([k,v])=>k!=="_init" && v?.meta?.active && Number(v?.meta?.expiresAt||0)>now)
    .sort((a,b)=>Number((b[1]?.meta?.createdAt||0))-Number((a[1]?.meta?.createdAt||0)));
    if(active.length){
    const [token, session] = active[0];
    const pts = Object.values(session.public?.recentPoints || {}).filter(Boolean).sort((a,b)=>Number(a.timestamp||0)-Number(b.timestamp||0));
    liveTrail.setLatLngs(pts.filter(p=>p.latitude!=null&&p.longitude!=null).map(p=>[Number(p.latitude),Number(p.longitude)]));
    updateNowUI(session.public?.lastPoint || null, `liveSessions/${token}`, pts);
    return;
    }
    const point = allHistoryPoints.length ? allHistoryPoints[allHistoryPoints.length-1] : null;
    liveTrail.setLatLngs([]);
    updateNowUI(point, "history/default");
    }
    async function logDeletion(kind, description){
    const entryRef = push(ref(db, "adminLogs/deletions"));
    await set(entryRef, { ts: Date.now(), kind, description, uid: auth.currentUser?.uid || null, email: auth.currentUser?.email || null });
    }
    async function logAction(kind, description){
    const entryRef = push(ref(db, "adminLogs/actions"));
    await set(entryRef, { ts: Date.now(), kind, description, uid: auth.currentUser?.uid || null, email: auth.currentUser?.email || null });
    }
    async function loadHistory(){
    const snap = await get(ref(db, "history/default"));
    const raw = snap.val() || {};
    allHistoryPoints = Object.values(raw).filter(Boolean).sort((a,b)=>Number(a.timestamp||0)-Number(b.timestamp||0));
    updateUsage();
    renderHistory();
    updateNowFromAvailableSources();
    }
    function buildShareUrl(token){
    return `https://mygpstrack.github.io/mygps/live.html?session=${encodeURIComponent(token)}`;
    }
    function getRecentSourcePoints(mode, pointsLimit){
    const limit = Math.max(2, Math.min(500, Number(pointsLimit || 100)));
    const livePoints = Object.values(liveDefaultData?.recentPoints || {}).filter(Boolean).sort((a,b)=>Number(a.timestamp||0)-Number(b.timestamp||0));
    const historyPoints = allHistoryPoints.filter(Boolean).sort((a,b)=>Number(a.timestamp||0)-Number(b.timestamp||0));
    if(mode==="live") return livePoints.slice(-limit);
    if(mode==="history") return historyPoints.slice(-limit);
    if(livePoints.length) return livePoints.slice(-limit);
    return historyPoints.slice(-limit);
    }
    function generateSessionToken(){
    const arr = new Uint8Array(24);
    crypto.getRandomValues(arr);
    return Array.from(arr, b => b.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")).join("");
    }
    async function createLiveSession(){
    const durationMinutes = Number(qs("shareDurationPreset").value || 60);
    const sourceMode = qs("shareSource").value;
    const pointsLimit = Number(qs("sharePointsLimit").value || 100);
    const sourcePoints = getRecentSourcePoints(sourceMode, pointsLimit);
    if(!sourcePoints.length){
    alert("Нет данных для создания live-ссылки.");
    return;
    }
    const token = generateSessionToken();
    const now = Date.now();
    const expiresAt = now + durationMinutes * 60 * 1000;
    const lastPoint = sourcePoints[sourcePoints.length-1];
    const recentPointsObj = {};
    sourcePoints.forEach(p => { recentPointsObj[String(p.timestamp||Date.now()+Math.random())] = p; });
    const payload = {
    meta: {
    active: true,
    createdAt: now,
    expiresAt,
    createdBy: auth.currentUser?.uid || null,
    createdByEmail: auth.currentUser?.email || null,
    durationMinutes
    },
    public: {
    lastPoint,
    recentPoints: recentPointsObj
    },
    viewStats: {
    openCount: 0,
    firstOpenAt: null,
    lastOpenAt: null
    }
    };
    await runSafe("Создание live-ссылки", async()=>{
    await set(ref(db, `liveSessions/${token}`), payload);
    await logAction("session_create", `Создана live-сессия ${token}`);
    createdShareUrl = buildShareUrl(token);
    qs("shareLinkText").textContent = createdShareUrl;
    qs("shareExpiresText").textContent = fmtTime(expiresAt);
    qs("shareResultBox").classList.remove("hidden");
    }, { reloadSessions:true, silentSuccess:true });
    }
    /* LIVE SESSIONS */
    function getSessionStatus(session){
    const meta = session?.meta || {};
    const active = !!meta.active;
    const expiresAt = Number(meta.expiresAt || 0);
    const now = Date.now();
    if (active && expiresAt > now) return "active";
    if (!active && expiresAt > now) return "ended";
    return "expired";
    }
    function getSessionStatusLabel(status){
    if (status === "active") return "активна";
    if (status === "ended") return "завершена";
    return "истекла";
    }
    async function loadSessions() {
    const snap = await get(ref(db, "liveSessions"));
    allSessions = snap.val() || {};
    updateUsage();
    renderSessions();
    updateNowFromAvailableSources();
    }
    async function deleteSession(token) {
    if (!confirm(`Удалить live-сессию ${token}?`)) return;
    await runSafe("Удаление live-сессии", async () => {
    await remove(ref(db, `liveSessions/${token}`));
    await logAction("session_delete", `Удалена live-сессия ${token}`);
    }, { reloadSessions: true, silentSuccess:true });
    }
    async function endSession(token) {
    if (!confirm(`Завершить live-сессию ${token}?`)) return;
    await runSafe("Завершение live-сессии", async () => {
    await update(ref(db, `liveSessions/${token}/meta`), {
    active: false,
    endedAt: Date.now()
    });
    await logAction("session_end", `Завершена live-сессия ${token}`);
    }, { reloadSessions: true, silentSuccess:true });
    }
    async function extendSession(token) {
    const minutes = Number(qs("extendSessionMinutesInput").value || 0);
    if (!minutes || minutes <= 0) {
    alert("Укажи минуты для продления.");
    return;
    }
    const session = allSessions[token];
    if (!session) {
    alert("Сессия не найдена.");
    return;
    }
    const currentExpiresAt = Number(session?.meta?.expiresAt || Date.now());
    const nextExpiresAt = Math.max(currentExpiresAt, Date.now()) + minutes * 60000;
    await runSafe("Продление live-сессии", async () => {
    await update(ref(db, `liveSessions/${token}/meta`), {
    expiresAt: nextExpiresAt,
    active: true,
    extendedAt: Date.now()
    });
    await logAction("session_extend", `Продлена live-сессия ${token}`);
    }, { reloadSessions: true, silentSuccess:true });
    }
    async function endAllActiveSessions() {
    const now = Date.now();
    const activeTokens = Object.entries(allSessions || {})
    .filter(([token, session]) => {
    if (token === "_init") return false;
    return !!session?.meta?.active && Number(session?.meta?.expiresAt || 0) > now;
    })
    .map(([token]) => token);
    if (!activeTokens.length) {
    alert("Активных live-сессий нет.");
    return;
    }
    if (!confirm(`Остановить ${activeTokens.length} активных сессий?`)) return;
    await runSafe("Остановка всех активных", async () => {
    for (const token of activeTokens) {
    await update(ref(db, `liveSessions/${token}/meta`), {
    active: false,
    endedAt: Date.now()
    });
    }
    await logAction("session_end_all", `Остановлено активных сессий: ${activeTokens.length}`);
    }, { reloadSessions: true, silentSuccess:true });
    }
    async function cleanupExpiredSessions() {
    const now = Date.now();
    const expiredTokens = Object.entries(allSessions || {})
    .filter(([token, session]) => {
    if (token === "_init") return false;
    const expiresAt = Number(session?.meta?.expiresAt || 0);
    return expiresAt > 0 && expiresAt < now;
    })
    .map(([token]) => token);
    if (!expiredTokens.length) {
    alert("Истёкших сессий не найдено.");
    return;
    }
    if (!confirm(`Удалить ${expiredTokens.length} истёкших сессий?`)) return;
    await runSafe("Очистка истёкших сессий", async () => {
    for (const token of expiredTokens) {
    await remove(ref(db, `liveSessions/${token}`));
    }
    await logAction("expired_sessions_cleanup", `Удалено истёкших сессий: ${expiredTokens.length}`);
    }, { reloadSessions: true, silentSuccess:true });
    }
    async function syncActiveSessionsFromLiveDefault() {
    if (!liveDefaultData?.lastPoint) {
    alert("Нет live/default для синхронизации.");
    return;
    }
    const now = Date.now();
    const activeTokens = Object.entries(allSessions || {})
    .filter(([token, session]) => {
    if (token === "_init") return false;
    return !!session?.meta?.active && Number(session?.meta?.expiresAt || 0) > now;
    })
    .map(([token]) => token);
    if (!activeTokens.length) {
    alert("Активных live-сессий нет.");
    return;
    }
    const livePoints = Object.values(liveDefaultData.recentPoints || {})
    .filter(Boolean)
    .sort((a, b) => Number(a.timestamp || 0) - Number(b.timestamp || 0))
    .slice(-100);
    const recentPointsObj = {};
    livePoints.forEach((p) => {
    recentPointsObj[String(p.timestamp || (Date.now() + Math.random()))] = p;
    });
    await runSafe("Синхронизация active-сессий", async () => {
    for (const token of activeTokens) {
    await update(ref(db, `liveSessions/${token}/public`), {
    lastPoint: liveDefaultData.lastPoint,
    recentPoints: recentPointsObj
    });
    await update(ref(db, `liveSessions/${token}/meta`), {
    lastSyncedAt: Date.now()
    });
    }
    await logAction("session_sync_active", `Синхронизировано active-сессий: ${activeTokens.length}`);
    }, { reloadSessions: true, silentSuccess:true });
    }
    function renderSessions() {
    const tbody = qs("sessionsTbody");
    tbody.innerHTML = "";
    const search = (qs("sessionSearchInput").value || "").trim().toLowerCase();
    const statusFilter = qs("sessionStatusFilter").value;
    const entries = Object.entries(allSessions || {})
    .filter(([token]) => token !== "_init")
    .map(([token, session]) => [token, session, getSessionStatus(session)])
    .filter(([token, session, status]) => {
    if (statusFilter !== "all" && status !== statusFilter) return false;
    if (search && !token.toLowerCase().includes(search)) return false;
    return true;
    })
    .sort((a, b) => {
    const weight = (status) => status === "active" ? 0 : status === "ended" ? 1 : 2;
    const diff = weight(a[2]) - weight(b[2]);
    if (diff !== 0) return diff;
    return Number((b[1]?.meta?.createdAt || 0)) - Number((a[1]?.meta?.createdAt || 0));
    });
